LOGO COMPANY.SOP: Supplier Qualification and Approval Standard Operating Procedure
LOGO COMPANY.Street Address,City,ST ZIP: 8500 Pioneer Parkway, Building C, Dayton, OH 45424

PROCESS OVERVIEW.Process Description: This procedure establishes a standardized, risk-based approach to evaluate, qualify, and approve new suppliers. It includes intake of sourcing needs, pre-qualification screening, financial and compliance checks, quality audits, technical capability assessment, negotiation of commercial terms, ERP vendor creation, and cross-functional approval to add suppliers to the Approved Supplier List (ASL).
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Purpose & Scope: Purpose: Ensure suppliers meet quality, compliance, ethical, and business requirements prior to onboarding. Scope: Applies to all new and reactivated suppliers providing direct materials, indirect goods, and critical services for Northstar Manufacturing Group. Involves Procurement, Quality, Finance, Legal, EHS/Sustainability, IT/ERP Administration, and Vendor Management teams.
PROCESS OVERVIEW.Definitions & Related Documents: Definitions: 'ASL' - Approved Supplier List; 'PPAP' - Production Part Approval Process; 'ERP' - Enterprise Resource Planning system; 'NDA' - Non-Disclosure Agreement. Related Documents: Supplier Onboarding Questionnaire, Quality Audit Checklist, Code of Conduct, Anti-Bribery & Corruption Policy, Sanctions Screening Procedure, Master Supply Agreement Template, NDA Template, Risk Assessment Matrix, ERP Vendor Creation Work Instruction.

PROCESS STEPS.Task: Receive supplier request or sourcing need and open qualification case
Issue pre-qualification questionnaire and collect certifications, tax forms, and insurance
Perform preliminary risk screening (commodity, geography, criticality)
Conduct financial health review and complete sanctions/denied party screening
Schedule and conduct quality audit (on-site or remote) per product risk
Evaluate technical capability and review samples or PPAP submissions as required
Complete compliance assessment (EHS, ethics, data security where applicable)
Negotiate commercial terms and draft Master Supply Agreement and NDA
Create supplier record in ERP and assign vendor number
Compile qualification package for cross-functional approval and add to ASL
Communicate approval decision and onboarding next steps to supplier
Set ordering parameters (pricing, lead times, Incoterms, contacts) in ERP
Define quality requirements and incoming inspection plan
Enroll supplier in performance monitoring (OTD, PPM, nonconformances)
Execute first article or initial order review and obtain sign-off
Hold 30-day review to assess onboarding progress and resolve issues
Conduct 60-day performance checkpoint and implement corrective actions if needed
Conduct 90-day supplier review and confirm approved status or remediation plan
